symptom: Enhanced Game Analysis never completed on the deployed Phase 8A preview; the panel showed a failure message and Retry did not help.
tracedOn: the deployed wave1 preview, with a real chaos result

rankedCauses.verdict: REJECTED — the Phase 8A state machine already polls 202 to a conclusion; the responses were 503, not 202
REJECTED — health reports aiNarrative ok and the provider returned content to validate
REJECTED — the same session completed the simulation and every other call
REJECTED — each attempt produced a fresh provider call and a fresh rejection

rootCause: validateNarrativeClaims allowed only the FINAL score as a legitimate N-N string. A competent recap cites a quarter score or a shooting line, both of which the record genuinely contains, so essentially every generated narrative was rejected as a fabrication and both retry attempts burned before degrading to MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.
proof: A real quarter score (21-28 from periodScores) and a real shooting line (19-31 from the box score) were both rejected by the validator in isolation.
fix: The allowed set is now every score the record contains — final, per period, running totals, and every made-attempted pair, individual and team. Invented scores and wrong player totals are still rejected, and single-digit fabrications the old regex could not see are now caught.
secondaryFix: A deterministic Expanded Game Analysis is always available, so a provider outage leaves a complete analysis rather than an empty panel.
